landing.heroDesc: TBL Virtual is the most complete platform for applying Team-Based Learning methodology. Create quizzes with AI, run all 3 phases in real time, and generate detailed reports — all in one place.
landing.aiQuizzesDesc: Upload a PDF, Word, or PPT and artificial intelligence automatically generates multiple-choice questions and clinical application cases with answer keys — in seconds.
landing.tblPhasesDesc: Individual iRAT with confidence bets, team tRAT with digital scratch card (IF-AT), and Application Exercises with complex scenarios — fully integrated.
landing.detailedReportsDesc: Final reports with weighted grades and management charts showing performance, grade distribution, question difficulty analysis, and topic performance.
landing.realTimeDesc: Instant sync between teacher and students. No page reload needed.
landing.noSignupDesc: Just a name and room code. Instant access from any phone.
landing.smartTimerDesc: Control iRAT time with a timer visible to everyone.
landing.confidenceBetsDesc: Distribute 4 points among alternatives. The more certain, the higher the bet.
landing.difficultyLevelDesc: Automatically identify easy, medium, and hard questions.
landing.weightedGradeDesc: Configurable weights for iRAT, tRAT, and Application. Automatic final grade.
